01 / FIND YOUR NEXT FORMAT

What goes in.
What comes next.

Choose a category to explore supported inputs,
outputs, and the details that matter.

Start withConvert toGood to know
PNG · JPG · WebP
AVIF · TIFF · GIF		PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, SVG, PDFGIF and TIFF use the first frame/page. SVG can embed the image losslessly or trace approximate editable paths.
SVGPNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, PDFRender at a chosen output width. Transparency is retained where the target format supports it.
TXT · Markdown · HTMLTXT, Markdown, HTML, PDFMarkdown-to-PDF supports headings, emphasis, lists, code, tables and local images. HTML conversion is text-oriented.
PDFAI-ready ZIP, PNG, JPG, WebP, TXT, MarkdownImage conversion uses page 1. AI-ready bundles preserve selected pages. Text exports need embedded text; optional local OCR applies to bundles.
JSONJSON, CSV, TSV, TXTCSV/TSV export expects an array of objects.
CSV · TSVCSV, TSV, JSON, TXTJSON conversion expects unique headers and matching row widths.

100 MB maximum input. Image decoding is limited to 80 megapixels. Originals and existing outputs are preserved.

02 / THE PDF WORKSPACE

More than
a change of format.

A focused editor inside Studio.
Keep your original. Save an edited copy.

01

Edit original text.

Select supported original text, replace its contents, adjust the font, size and styling, or delete the active text.

02

Work with images.

Remove or replace supported embedded images. Add your own images, then move and resize them.

03

Leave a clear note.

Comments, highlights, underlines, strikeouts, freehand ink and rectangles. Update supported saved annotations.

04

Make pages work.

Scroll, search, zoom, reorder, rotate, duplicate or remove pages. Add blank pages or merge ordinary PDFs.

05

Fill and sign.

Fill standard interactive form fields and add a drawn signature as a visual image mark.

06

Room to revise.

Undo and redo edits, adjust exact positions and sizes, and save a new PDF without overwriting the source.

Supported content matters. Scanned and complex text may be read-only. Nested, clipped and arbitrarily rotated images are unsupported. No full paragraph reflow, secure redaction or cryptographic signing.

03 / CHOOSE YOUR FLOW

The quick way.
Or the considered way.

The wheel for a small task.
Studio for everything around it.

QUICK WHEEL

Right where you work.

Option+C for selected Finder files. Option/Alt-drag on supported desktops. Keyboard selection, scroll ticks and optional sounds.

IMAGE CONTROLS

Give it the right shape.

Crop with aspect presets or exact coordinates. Resize, mirror, flip and set output quality. SVG rendering can use a requested resolution.

STUDIO

A queue with a clear view.

Up to 100 files, per-file settings, original and converted previews, an output folder picker and session results.

AI-READY PDF

Keep the whole picture.

Page PNGs, text, structured Markdown chunks, detected tables and a source manifest. Choose page ranges and visual detail.

MARKDOWN

Structure that travels.

Infer PDF headings, ruled tables and monospaced code. Export Markdown to a formatted PDF with readable type and tables.

DESKTOP UTILITY

Quietly available.

Tray access, optional launch at login, native Studio menus, dark/light appearance and a remembered collapsible sidebar.

macOS has native Liquid Glass on supported versions. Windows and Linux use a monochrome fallback. Wayland and unsupported drag environments use a floating drop target. OCR needs installed Tesseract.
